newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan may cancel Oct jet fuel buy tender-official.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan may cancel Oct jet fuel buy tender-official.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) might cancel a tender to buy jet fuel for delivery in October due to the high offer prices, a company official said on Thursday.
The tender to buy 32,000 tonnes of jet fuel for October 10-20 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung or Shen Ao closed on September 4 and will be valid until September 6.
"We are seriously considering cancelling the tender but it is subject to the management's approval," the official said.
CPC was having second thoughts about awarding the tender because the lowest offer received was above $240 per tonne, the source added.
The best offer price was around $20 above the awarded level in its last jet fuel tender for September 20-30 delivery which was awarded at $228.50 per tonne, c-and-f basis.
The closing date of the latest tender came a day after the U.S. launched its first missile attack on Iraq resulting in a sharp price hike.
The knee-jerk jump in prices is being corrected and CPC should get lower offers prices if it reissues the tender, traders said.
